SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS earliest_date, MAX(calendar_date) AS latest_date
FROM dim_date;

SELECT 
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_net,
  SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_net,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND fsl.sale_date < '2026-10-01';

SELECT 
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date < '2026-10-01';

SELECT 
  SUM(refund_net) AS total_returns_net
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date >= '2026-09-01' AND return_date < '2026-10-01';

SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS total_before, SUM(returns_net) AS total_returns, SUM(net_sales) AS total_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS total_before_returns,
  SUM(returns_net) AS total_returns,
  SUM(net_sales) AS total_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01';

SELECT 
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_with_staff,
  SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag = true THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_purchases_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag = false OR staff_purchase_flag IS NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS regular_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date < '2026-10-01';
